3d_prints.description: 3D printable models and CAD files (.stl, .3mf, .step, .gcode) from Printables, Thingiverse, MakerWorld, or CAD tools

code_configs.description: Source code scripts, JSON/YAML/TOML configs, SQL dumps, CSV datasets, and developer logs (excluding Betaflight dumps and office spreadsheets)

documents_notes.description: Word (.docx/.doc/.rtf) documents, PDFs, Markdown notes, articles, manuals, guides, contracts, boarding passes/tickets, resumes/CVs, ebooks, presentations, and spreadsheets

career_resumes.description: CVs, resumes, cover letters, diplomas, certificates, transcripts, and job descriptions

contracts_official.description: Leases, contracts, NDAs, legal agreements, terms, government/bank/insurance letters, and official administrative forms

decks_sheets.description: Slide presentations (.pptx, .key, pitch decks), spreadsheets (.xlsx, .numbers, budget/tracker tables), and structured business reports

manuals_guides.description: Hardware/product user manuals, datasheets, technical specifications, setup instructions, and how-to reference guides

notes.description: Personal Markdown/text notes, meeting minutes, checklists, scratchpad drafts, and short writeups

papers_books.description: Academic research papers (arXiv, DOI, abstract/citations), whitepapers, ebooks (.epub or multi-chapter books), textbooks, and long-form articles

tickets_travel.description: Boarding passes, flight/train/event tickets, hotel bookings, travel itineraries, and reservation passes

fpv_hobby.description: Hobby RC FPV quadcopter files: Betaflight CLI diff/dump backups, Blackbox logs (.bbl/.bfl), BetaFPV flight controller wiring/pinout diagrams, ELRS/Bluejay firmware, and FPV OSD flight clips

installers_archives.description: macOS app installers (.dmg, .pkg), general software .zip/.tar.gz archives, and system utilities

invoices_finance.description: Paid/unpaid invoices, payment receipts, Stripe/PayPal billing statements, tax returns, bank statements, and purchase order confirmations

media_photos.description: Personal camera photos, wallpapers, memes, music/audio recordings, and general non-FPV videos

screenshots_ui.description: General app/UI screenshots, terminal/error screen captures, chat snippets, and web page captures (excluding invoices, tickets, or FPV pinout diagrams)
